title: Enable CoreDNS and NodeLocalDNS
description: Enable the NodeLocal DNSCache addon on a GKE cluster to relieve high-concurrency DNS lookup bottlenecks. Run by the cluster admin: on an existing cluster this recreates the nodes (kills running workloads), so drain or schedule it first. The CoreDNS engine is not switched by this command (see kubedns-troubleshooting).

location.description: GCP location (region or zone) of the cluster.
